name: Vault Stack
description: Add 20,000 game cash to your saved balance.

name: Treasure Chest
description: Add 50,000 game cash to your saved balance.

name: Grand Fortune
description: Add 100,000 game cash to your saved balance.

name: One Base Level
description: Add 1 base level and another 5% of base item income to your income bonus.

name: Five Base Levels
description: Add 5 base levels and another 25% of base item income to your income bonus.

name: Dash Unlock
description: Unlock Dash for a quick movement burst that respects solid walls.

name: Pull Unlock
description: Unlock Pull to draw nearby opponents inward and interrupt their grabs.

name: Slow Field Unlock
description: Unlock Slow Field to aim a slowing zone that can knock carried loot loose.

name: Ground Slam Unlock
description: Unlock Ground Slam to erupt the ground and knock nearby opponents' carried loot loose.

name: Knockback Pulse Unlock
description: Unlock Knockback Pulse to blast nearby opponents outward and knock carried loot loose.

name: Force Field Shield Unlock
description: Unlock a shield that lasts up to 3 seconds and blocks one incoming hit.

name: Lightning Strike Unlock
description: Unlock Lightning Strike to lock onto a nearby visible opponent, briefly stun them and drop their carried loot.

name: Ki Blast Unlock
description: Unlock Ki Blast to fire an aimed energy projectile with an explosion that can knock carried loot loose.

name: Spinjitzu Unlock
description: Unlock Spinjitzu to surround yourself with a short tornado that knocks nearby opponents back and drops carried loot.
